resolutions: The plan replaces the fixture Agents surface in one bounded story decomposition and removes its obsolete preview seams rather than retaining compatibility paths.
Custom role templates are the only new durable domain; agent source/capability, browser-auth, profile, model, and conversation boundaries reuse existing services.
The UI is split by directory/library, creation flow, and detail responsibility; no single feature file contains multiple pages.
Every backend task is marked user_facing false and every visible-screen task is marked true, so required design and functional gates apply at the right boundary.
The existing delivery-semantics recurring finding is unrelated to this story; the plan records a tripwire for any recurring finding in the Agents area.
current_flow: Existing Web routes use preview data and connection-gate controls. Existing core services separately own agent profile versions, access replacements, source bindings, semantic capability selections, and browser authentication policy.

criteria_map.Directory and URL states: Tasks 2 and 3 add paginated projection and directory/library UI; task 6 verifies server/UI states.
criteria_map.Role lifecycle: Tasks 1 and 2 add persistence, snapshot composition, browser operations, and task 3 presents them.
criteria_map.Creation lifecycle: Tasks 1 and 2 keep separate server operations; task 4 presents the staged flow and task 6 proves partial saves.
criteria_map.Authority boundary: Tasks 1 and 2 reuse the existing source/capability model; task 4 teaches it without adding raw MCP grants.
criteria_map.Truthful detail and control behavior: Tasks 2 and 5 project real values and remove preview/no-op controls; task 6 audits the shipped surface.
criteria_map.Browser security: Task 2 reuses browser boundary checks and has focused facade tests.

new_abstractions: Custom-role template domain and its browser DTOs only.
No new UI framework, browser-auth layer, access model, or atomic setup endpoint.

citations.finding: No compatibility surface should remain for a fixture-only early-stage UI.
Source attachment and semantic capability authorization must stay separate throughout the wizard and details.
Agent deletion remains out of scope; disablement preserves projection history.
Same-origin browser operations must not share the Bearer Control API trust path.
